text:
sarah_oncall: FYI: we're seeing sustained tail latency increases for eu-hosted model inference (eu1 region). Impact: ~12% of requests hitting p95 > 900ms since 10:02 UTC. Customer-facing errors are low, but LLM response times are spiking. Investigating. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2801239099

kevin_infra: Noted. I'm pulling scheduler and queue metrics now. Initial hypothesis: autoscale cooldown + sudden long-context requests causing KV cache churn.

ops-bot: automated alert: eu1-serving-pool: p95 latency 920ms (+340ms), concurrent inflight 2.1k, queue depth 420, batch sizes avg 3.2 -> 10:07:45 UTC

marta_prod: tagging customers with high tail latencies so support can notify if needed. ETA for a mitigation?

sarah_oncall: Short term: rate-limit large-context requests to 2rps per token-length > 8k for free tier; ramp down noncritical background eval work in eu1. I've enabled a temporary route to fallback smaller-quantized variant (gptx-lite) for requests > 2048 tokens. Will monitor.

josh_research: Quick note: model variant is quantized but some kernels are switching to fallback path increasing per-token CPU. I can push a micro-config to prefer fused-kernel path on specific instance types (requires a rolling restart of 8 nodes). Approve?

kevin_infra: Approve for nodes in eu1-serving-pool-2 (non-customer-dedicated). Rolling restart plan: 1 node at a time, healthcheck 30s, canary 2 nodes first. I'll schedule; expected 10-12m.

marta_prod: I'll draft a short customer note:
- What happened: transient tail latency increase in EU hosted inference
- Impact: slowed responses, no widespread 5xxs
- Mitigation: temporary rate limits and fallback to gptx-lite; rolling infra restart underway
- Next update: 30m or when resolved.

statusbot: Incident created: #INC-2026-2801239099 -> https://internal.ops.redwood/INC-2026-2801239099

ops-bot: logs snippet (10:04:12 UTC):
```
[worker-17] KV_CACHE_EVICT key=ctx-usr-12345 size=14MB, active_kv_hit=0.03
[worker-17] kernel_fallback: slow_path_ms=12.4
[worker-21] batch_size=1 token_len=10240
```

sarah_oncall: Rolling restart started at 10:10 UTC. Monitoring queue depth and p95.

ops-bot: metric update (10:12 UTC): queue depth -> 310, p95 -> 680ms, inflight -> 1.8k

josh_research: after canary nodes back up, p95 on canary dropped to 210ms for test workload. Looks promising.

marta_prod: Sending proactive note to customers who had >1s replies in past 24h. Patch to status page with mitigations.

sarah_oncall: Current status: mitigation in progress, no customer 5xxs, reduced tail latency on canary. Next check-in 10:30 UTC or when fully rolled. If you have capacity to pause any non-critical batch jobs in eu1, please do so now. :pray:

kevin_infra: Rolling restart moving to remaining nodes. Will report when complete.

ops-bot: metric update (10:25 UTC): p95 220ms, queue depth 90, inflight 950.

sarah_oncall: Resolved: service restored to normal p95 (~200-260ms) at 10:28 UTC after rolling kernel-pref change and rate limits. Postmortem will follow with root cause and long-term fixes (KV cache eviction policy + better kernel selection). Closing incident thread now but leaving ticket open for postmortem.

marta_prod: +1 on postmortem. I'll coordinate customer comms and share draft in #customer-success.

josh_research: Will add reproducer and perf traces to the incident ticket.

statusbot: Incident INC-2026-2801239099 transitioned to "Monitoring" -> "Resolved" in 00:26:00.
